cohort: This study included 744 patients with prenatally diagnosed placenta accreta spectrum and confirmed histopathologic findings from referral centers within the Pan-American Society for Placenta Accreta Spectrum.
finding: Less than half of patients with placenta accreta spectrum had a scheduled delivery within the recommended gestational age window, but maternal outcomes were similar for those who delivered within the recommended window compared to those delivering 2 weeks before or after, regardless of placenta accreta spectrum severity.
